svg.aria-label: Applied AI and automation engineer. Agent systems, LLM evaluation, process automation. Chicago metro, open to full-time roles, onsite, hybrid or remote. A noisy signal passes four stages and comes out clean. Notice: workflow profiling, bottleneck hunting, repeat-task audits, shop-floor context. Build: agents and tool use, MCP servers, local LLMs, scripts and macros. Measure: eval harnesses, LLM-as-judge, hand-timed baselines, deterministic checks before judges. Ship: unit tests, SOPs and onboarding, sandboxed runs, a human review gate. Results: 3 to 5 times faster than by hand at 99.9 percent accuracy; about 2,800 unit tests in a local agent system; zero-token deterministic checks run before any judge; models run on one 16 GB GPU. Path: audio engineering, manufacturing, automation and AI. Stack: Python, TypeScript, Node.js, MCP, Claude Code, local LLMs, AutoHotkey, Zapier, Make, Linux, Docker, Git.
